findings.evidence: eisensteinSet at lines 85–87 imposes only an upper-bound condition on the constant coefficient; coeff_monicOfCoeff_self gives coefficient 1 when n = 0. The bridge's local-field assumptions begin at line 97.
findings.fix: Describe the defining valuation inequalities generally; qualify the uniformizer description by positive degree and the polynomial bridge by the local-field assumptions. Document the degree-zero case in both descriptions.
findings.issue: The definition docstring and module introduction (lines 23–26) say the constant term has uniformizer valuation without restricting to positive degree. For n = 0, the region contains the unique empty vector and its polynomial has constant term 1. The definition docstring also states the Eisenstein interpretation under only ValuativeRel, whereas the cited bridge assumes a nonarchimedean local field.

summary: The Eisenstein region documentation overstates its constant-term condition and the generality of its polynomial interpretation.
